rules.label: Sharpe Ratio
rules.description: Fund Sharpe Ratio must exceed Benchmark Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund - Growth Plan - Direct Plan

insights: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund - Growth Plan - Direct Plan decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 5.60% (15.95% vs 10.35%).
Beat the benchmark in 100.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Hybrid: Dynamic Asset Allocation.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 0.99 vs benchmark 0.81, Sortino 1.30.
Aggressive profile: beta 1.45 with 16.1% annualised volatility vs benchmark 9.8%.
Positive alpha of 4.34% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.92).
Drawdown protection: max drawdown -21.45% vs benchmark -11.54% — shallower losses in downturns.
Rolling return range spans 13.55% to 18.60% (5.05 pp spread) — consistency score 100.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
